+#!/bin/bash -e
+
+# Deploy proxy server to GCP VM with random port
+# This script builds and deploys the proxy server to a GCP Compute Engine instance
+# Usage: ./scripts/deploy_proxy_server_gcp.sh [PROJECT_ID] [ZONE] [INSTANCE_NAME]
+
+GCP_PROJECT_ID="${1:-platformx-sdbx-sdbx-mb0e}"
+GCP_ZONE="${2:-us-central1-c}"
+GCP_INSTANCE_NAME="${3:-fsc-proxy}"
+
+# Use TEST_RUN_ID for isolation, fallback to basic ID if not set
+if [ -z "$TEST_RUN_ID" ]; then
+    TEST_RUN_ID="${SDK:-unknown}-${BUILD_NUMBER:-unknown}-$(head /dev/urandom | tr -dc a-z0-9 | head -c 5)"
+fi
+
+# Generate coordinated port allocation
+if [ -z "$PROXYSERVER_PORT" ]; then
+    if [ "$USE_FIXED_PORT" = "true" ]; then
+        export PROXYSERVER_PORT=35201
+        echo "Using fixed port allocation: $PROXYSERVER_PORT"
+    else
+        export PROXYSERVER_PORT=$(node scripts/allocate_port_with_retry.js "$TEST_RUN_ID")
+        echo "Using random port allocation: $PROXYSERVER_PORT"
+    fi
+fi
+
+echo "Deploying proxy server to GCP VM:"
+echo "  Project: $GCP_PROJECT_ID"
+echo "  Zone: $GCP_ZONE" 
+echo "  Instance: $GCP_INSTANCE_NAME"
+echo "  Port: $PROXYSERVER_PORT"
+echo "  Port Mode: $([ "$USE_FIXED_PORT" = "true" ] && echo "Fixed (35201)" || echo "Random (30000-60000)")"
+echo "  Test Run ID: $TEST_RUN_ID"
+
+# Get the external IP of the GCP instance
+echo "Getting VM external IP..."
+VM_EXTERNAL_IP=$(gcloud compute instances describe $GCP_INSTANCE_NAME \
+    --zone=$GCP_ZONE \
+    --project=$GCP_PROJECT_ID \
+    --format='get(networkInterfaces[0].accessConfigs[0].natIP)')
+
+if [ -z "$VM_EXTERNAL_IP" ]; then
+    echo "ERROR: Could not get external IP for instance $GCP_INSTANCE_NAME"
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+echo "VM External IP: $VM_EXTERNAL_IP"
+
+# Build proxy server Docker image
+echo "Building proxy server Docker image..."
+docker build -t proxy-server:latest ./services/proxy_server/
+
+# Save the image to a tar file
+echo "Exporting Docker image..."
+docker save proxy-server:latest > proxy-server.tar
+
+# Copy image to GCP VM
+echo "Copying Docker image to GCP VM..."
+gcloud compute scp proxy-server.tar $GCP_INSTANCE_NAME:/tmp/proxy-server-${TEST_RUN_ID}.tar \
+    --zone=$GCP_ZONE \
+    --project=$GCP_PROJECT_ID
+
+# Copy certificates to GCP VM
+echo "Copying certificates to GCP VM..."
+gcloud compute scp --recurse ./certs $GCP_INSTANCE_NAME:/tmp/certs-${TEST_RUN_ID} \
+    --zone=$GCP_ZONE \
+    --project=$GCP_PROJECT_ID
+
+# Copy datafiles to GCP VM
+echo "Copying datafiles to GCP VM..."
+gcloud compute scp --recurse ./features/support/datafiles $GCP_INSTANCE_NAME:/tmp/datafiles-${TEST_RUN_ID} \
+    --zone=$GCP_ZONE \
+    --project=$GCP_PROJECT_ID
+
+# Deploy and run on GCP VM
+echo "Deploying proxy server on GCP VM..."
+gcloud compute ssh $GCP_INSTANCE_NAME \
+    --zone=$GCP_ZONE \
+    --project=$GCP_PROJECT_ID \
+    --command="
+# Ensure Docker is running
+sudo systemctl start docker 2>/dev/null || true
+
+# Load Docker image
+sudo docker load < /tmp/proxy-server-${TEST_RUN_ID}.tar
+
+# Stop any existing proxy server containers for this test run
+sudo docker stop proxy-server-${TEST_RUN_ID} 2>/dev/null || true
+sudo docker rm proxy-server-${TEST_RUN_ID} 2>/dev/null || true
+
+# Create directories for volumes (isolated per test run)
+mkdir -p /tmp/proxy-volumes-${TEST_RUN_ID}/datafiles
+mkdir -p /tmp/proxy-volumes-${TEST_RUN_ID}/certs
+
+# Copy files to volume directories
+cp -r /tmp/datafiles-${TEST_RUN_ID}/* /tmp/proxy-volumes-${TEST_RUN_ID}/datafiles/
+cp -r /tmp/certs-${TEST_RUN_ID}/* /tmp/proxy-volumes-${TEST_RUN_ID}/certs/
+
+# Run proxy server container with unique name and isolated volumes
+sudo docker run -d \
+  --name proxy-server-${TEST_RUN_ID} \
+  -p $PROXYSERVER_PORT:3001 \
+  -v /tmp/proxy-volumes-${TEST_RUN_ID}/datafiles:/usr/src/app/public:ro \
+  -v /tmp/proxy-volumes-${TEST_RUN_ID}/certs:/usr/src/app/certs:ro \
+  proxy-server:latest
+
+# Wait for proxy server to start
+sleep 5
+
+# Check if proxy server is running
+if sudo docker ps | grep -q proxy-server-${TEST_RUN_ID}; then
+    echo 'Proxy server deployed successfully on port $PROXYSERVER_PORT (test run: ${TEST_RUN_ID})'
+else
+    echo 'Failed to deploy proxy server for test run: ${TEST_RUN_ID}'
+    sudo docker logs proxy-server-${TEST_RUN_ID}
+    exit 1
+fi
+"
+
+# Verify deployment
+echo "Verifying proxy server deployment..."
+HEALTH_CHECK=$(gcloud compute ssh $GCP_INSTANCE_NAME \
+    --zone=$GCP_ZONE \
+    --project=$GCP_PROJECT_ID \
+    --command="curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:$PROXYSERVER_PORT/ || echo 'FAILED'")
+
+if [ "$HEALTH_CHECK" = "200" ] || [ "$HEALTH_CHECK" = "404" ]; then
+    echo "✅ Proxy server is responding (test run: $TEST_RUN_ID)"
+else
+    echo "⚠️  Proxy server health check returned: $HEALTH_CHECK (test run: $TEST_RUN_ID)"
+fi
+
+# Clean up local files
+rm -f proxy-server.tar
+
+# Export environment variables for use by other scripts
+echo "export PROXYSERVER_HOST=$VM_EXTERNAL_IP" > .proxy_env
+echo "export PROXYSERVER_PORT=$PROXYSERVER_PORT" >> .proxy_env
+echo "export PROXYSERVER_INTERNAL_PORT=3001" >> .proxy_env
+echo "export PROXYSERVER_URL=http://$VM_EXTERNAL_IP:$PROXYSERVER_PORT" >> .proxy_env
+echo "export TEST_RUN_ID=$TEST_RUN_ID" >> .proxy_env
+
+echo "Proxy server deployment completed!"
+echo "Proxy server accessible at: http://$VM_EXTERNAL_IP:$PROXYSERVER_PORT"
+echo "PROXYSERVER_URL: http://$VM_EXTERNAL_IP:$PROXYSERVER_PORT"
+echo "Test Run ID: $TEST_RUN_ID"
+echo "Environment variables saved to .proxy_env"

+#!/bin/bash -e
+
+# Deploy proxy server to VM with random port
+# This script builds and deploys the proxy server to a remote VM
+# Usage: ./scripts/deploy_proxy_server_vm.sh [VM_HOST] [SSH_KEY_PATH]
+
+VM_HOST="${1:-136.112.201.144}"
+SSH_KEY_PATH="${2:-}"
+VM_USER="${VM_USER:-ubuntu}"
+
+# Generate random port if not set
+if [ -z "$PROXYSERVER_PORT" ]; then
+    export PROXYSERVER_PORT=$(node scripts/generate_random_port.js)
+fi
+
+echo "Deploying proxy server to VM: $VM_HOST"
+echo "Using port: $PROXYSERVER_PORT"
+
+# SSH options
+SSH_OPTS="-o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null"
+if [ -n "$SSH_KEY_PATH" ]; then
+    SSH_OPTS="$SSH_OPTS -i $SSH_KEY_PATH"
+fi
+
+# Build proxy server Docker image
+echo "Building proxy server Docker image..."
+sudo docker build -t proxy-server:latest ./services/proxy_server/
+
+# Save the image to a tar file
+echo "Exporting Docker image..."
+sudo docker save proxy-server:latest > proxy-server.tar
+
+# Copy image to VM
+echo "Copying Docker image to VM..."
+scp $SSH_OPTS proxy-server.tar $VM_USER@$VM_HOST:/tmp/
+
+# Copy certificates to VM
+echo "Copying certificates to VM..."
+scp $SSH_OPTS -r ./certs $VM_USER@$VM_HOST:/tmp/
+
+# Copy datafiles to VM
+echo "Copying datafiles to VM..."
+scp $SSH_OPTS -r ./features/support/datafiles $VM_USER@$VM_HOST:/tmp/
+
+# Deploy and run on VM
+echo "Deploying proxy server on VM..."
+ssh $SSH_OPTS $VM_USER@$VM_HOST << EOF
+# Ensure Docker is running
+sudo systemctl start docker 2>/dev/null || true
+
+# Load Docker image
+sudo docker load < /tmp/proxy-server.tar
+
+# Stop any existing proxy server containers
+sudo docker stop proxy-server 2>/dev/null || true
+sudo docker rm proxy-server 2>/dev/null || true
+
+# Create directories for volumes
+mkdir -p /tmp/proxy-volumes/datafiles
+mkdir -p /tmp/proxy-volumes/certs
+
+# Copy files to volume directories
+cp -r /tmp/datafiles/* /tmp/proxy-volumes/datafiles/
+cp -r /tmp/certs/* /tmp/proxy-volumes/certs/
+
+# Run proxy server container
+sudo docker run -d \
+  --name proxy-server \
+  -p $PROXYSERVER_PORT:3001 \
+  -v /tmp/proxy-volumes/datafiles:/usr/src/app/public:ro \
+  -v /tmp/proxy-volumes/certs:/usr/src/app/certs:ro \
+  proxy-server:latest
+
+# Wait for proxy server to start
+sleep 5
+
+# Check if proxy server is running
+if docker ps | grep -q proxy-server; then
+    echo "Proxy server deployed successfully on port $PROXYSERVER_PORT"
+else
+    echo "Failed to deploy proxy server"
+    docker logs proxy-server
+    exit 1
+fi
+EOF
+
+# Clean up local files
+rm -f proxy-server.tar
+
+# Export environment variables for use by other scripts
+echo "export PROXYSERVER_HOST=$VM_HOST" > .proxy_env
+echo "export PROXYSERVER_PORT=$PROXYSERVER_PORT" >> .proxy_env
+echo "export PROXYSERVER_INTERNAL_PORT=3001" >> .proxy_env
+
+echo "Proxy server deployment completed!"
+echo "Proxy server accessible at: http://$VM_HOST:$PROXYSERVER_PORT"
+echo "Environment variables saved to .proxy_env"

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+
+/**
+ * Generate a random port number for proxy server deployment
+ * Returns a port number between 3000-9999 that's not commonly used
+ */
+
+const generateRandomPort = () => {
+  // Generate random port between 30000-60000 
+  // This range avoids well-known ports and system reserved ranges
+  const MIN_PORT = 30000;
+  const MAX_PORT = 60000;
+  
+  // Generate random port in the specified range
+  const port = Math.floor(Math.random() * (MAX_PORT - MIN_PORT + 1)) + MIN_PORT;
+  
+  return port;
+};
+
+// If run as a script, output the port
+if (require.main === module) {
+  console.log(generateRandomPort());
+}
+
+module.exports = { generateRandomPort };

+#!/bin/bash
+
+# Monitor concurrent proxy server deployments on GCP VM
+# Usage: ./scripts/monitor_concurrent_deployments.sh [GCP_INSTANCE_NAME] [GCP_ZONE] [GCP_PROJECT_ID]
+
+GCP_INSTANCE_NAME="${1:-fsc-proxy}"
+GCP_ZONE="${2:-us-central1-c}"
+GCP_PROJECT_ID="${3:-platformx-sdbx-sdbx-mb0e}"
+
+echo "🔍 Monitoring Concurrent Proxy Server Deployments"
+echo "=================================================="
+echo "Instance: $GCP_INSTANCE_NAME"
+echo "Zone: $GCP_ZONE"
+echo "Project: $GCP_PROJECT_ID"
+echo ""
+
+# Function to run command on GCP VM
+run_on_vm() {
+    gcloud compute ssh $GCP_INSTANCE_NAME \
+        --zone=$GCP_ZONE \
+        --project=$GCP_PROJECT_ID \
+        --command="$1" 2>/dev/null
+}
+
+echo "📊 Active Proxy Server Containers:"
+echo "=================================="
+run_on_vm "docker ps --filter 'name=proxy-server-' --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Ports}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.RunningFor}}'"
+echo ""
+
+echo "📊 Port Usage:"
+echo "=============="
+run_on_vm "netstat -tuln | grep ':3[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9] ' | sort"
+echo ""
+
+echo "📊 Port Locks:"
+echo "=============="
+run_on_vm "ls -la /tmp/port-locks/port-* 2>/dev/null | head -20 || echo 'No port locks found'"
+echo ""
+
+echo "📊 Active Test Run Directories:"
+echo "==============================="
+run_on_vm "ls -la /tmp/ | grep -E '(proxy-volumes|datafiles|certs)-.*-.*-' | head -20 || echo 'No test run directories found'"
+echo ""
+
+echo "📊 Docker Container Resource Usage:"
+echo "==================================="
+run_on_vm "docker stats --no-stream --format 'table {{.Container}}\t{{.CPUPerc}}\t{{.MemUsage}}\t{{.NetIO}}' $(docker ps --filter 'name=proxy-server-' -q) 2>/dev/null || echo 'No running proxy containers'"
+echo ""
+
+echo "📊 Disk Usage:"
+echo "=============="
+run_on_vm "df -h /tmp/ | tail -1"
+echo ""
+
+echo "📊 System Load:"
+echo "==============="
+run_on_vm "uptime"
+echo ""
+
+echo "📊 Memory Usage:"
+echo "================"
+run_on_vm "free -h"
+echo ""
+
+# Count active deployments
+ACTIVE_CONTAINERS=$(run_on_vm "docker ps --filter 'name=proxy-server-' -q | wc -l")
+ACTIVE_DIRECTORIES=$(run_on_vm "ls -d /tmp/proxy-volumes-*-*-* 2>/dev/null | wc -l")
+
+echo "📈 Summary:"
+echo "==========="
+echo "Active proxy containers: $ACTIVE_CONTAINERS"
+echo "Active test directories: $ACTIVE_DIRECTORIES"
+
+if [ "$ACTIVE_CONTAINERS" -gt 1 ]; then
+    echo "✅ Multiple concurrent deployments detected!"
+else
+    echo "ℹ️  Single or no deployment currently active"
+fi
+
+echo ""
+echo "🔄 This script can be run periodically to monitor concurrent test execution"
+echo "💡 Use 'watch -n 30 ./scripts/monitor_concurrent_deployments.sh' for continuous monitoring"
